I have a direct gas line instead of using the small propane tank.  My Weber dealer (Ace Hardware) assured me that my new grill will easily hook up to my gas line.  He even delivered my assembled grill and when I showed him the gas line, he said no problem.

Turns out, you need a special adapter that can only be installed by a plumber.  And Weber is out of that part and I don't expect to get it this summer at all.  So I had to buy the part $80, and hire a plumber.

Originally, the Ace Hardware salesperson said "no problem".  I now have a brand new grill that's just sitting there not being used

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback and for being a Weber griller! We are sorry to learn you are disappointed with your grill's heat output. That's not the experience we expect.

If your grill is not reaching the desired temperature, there are a few things to check. Let's start with the easy stuff:

1.) Please make sure you consider "High" on your control knobs to be the first spot to your left (the 9:00 position). The further you go to the right the lower the temperature will be and all the way to the right is low except for designated Sear Boost knob areas.

2.) Please make sure you're always cooking with the lid down except when flipping the food halfway. The second you open the lid the heat escapes, and you'll need to close it to let the temperature recover.

3.) It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. 

Perform a soapy water leak test to check for leaks. If there is no leak, follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset, but how you want to light your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds - This is the MOST important part.
Turn light the first burner and leave it on high
Turn on remaining burners one at a time and set each to high
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 450°F-500°F 

Our Specialist team is here to help. Please look for our email outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: So far, I love it!  I’ve been without a grill for over a year and picked this up during Memorial Day.  The sear feature is my favorite.  My old grill didn’t sear well and things ended up dry.  This thing sears super well and everything has come out perfect so far.  My only hiccup is that the knobs are a little counter intuitive.  The sear setting (the hottest it will go) is beyond the low setting.  Most knobs got from “ignite” to “low” to “high”.  Weber goes “ignite” to “high” to “low” to “sear”.  Twice I’ve lit the grill and out of habit turned the knob all the way over only to find out that I had set it at the lowest temp.  Oh, well…something I’ll get used to.  For the way this thing grills, it’s worth the small hassle.
Results.Title: Cooks a mean meal!
